name: ReflectionFormat
description: Represents the reflection formatting for a shape or range of shapes.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns or sets an MsoLightRigType constant that represents the type and direction of the lighting for a shape reflection. Read/write.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified ReflectionFormat object.

properties.name: Transparency
properties.description: Returns or sets the degree of transparency for the reflection effect as a value between 0.0 (opaque) and 1.0 (clear). Read/write Single.

properties.name: Size
properties.description: Returns or sets the size of the reflection as a percentage of the reflected shape from 0 to 100. Read/write.

properties.name: Offset
properties.description: Returns or sets the amount of separation, in points, of the reflected image from the shape. Read/write.

properties.name: Blur
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that specifies the degree of blur effect applied to the specified object. Read/write.
